top_story.title: Bull market turns 4: Buy highs or wait for a dip?
top_story.summary: The S&P 500 bull market turns 4 and the index is holding above 7,800, so LPL Financial’s Adam Turnquist breaks down the key levels to watch, from the 7,600 pullback zone to the 8,000 target. He also covers Nvidia, Microsoft, Citigroup and this week’s big bank earnings, and whether to buy the ...
